area: Runner sync governance / Git commit adapter
finding: A task-owned runner-sync receipt can mark release mirror outputs as `owned-current` and `published`, but `node atm.mjs git commit --task <task> --auto-stage` still classifies the same release files as `skippedExternalDirtyFiles`, leaving `broker runner-sync release` blocked by `ATM_RUNNER_PUBLICATION_PENDING` unless an emergency path-bounded native commit is used.
expectedBehavior: When runner-sync output inventory marks release surfaces as owned by the active task, the governed commit adapter should include those exact release outputs in the publication bundle or surface a dedicated normal recovery command that commits them without emergency bypass.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0277: runner-sync receipt `.atm/history/evidence/ATM-GOV-0277.runner-sync-receipt.json` listed `.atm/history/evidence/ATM-GOV-0277.runner-sync-receipt.json`, `release/atm-onefile/atm.mjs`, `release/atm-onefile/release-manifest.json`, `release/atm-root-drop/packages/core/dist/evidence/index.js`, `release/atm-root-drop/packages/core/src/evidence/index.ts`, and `release/atm-root-drop/release-manifest.json` as `owned-current`; `node atm.mjs git commit --actor codex-skl-captain --task ATM-GOV-0277 --message "build(release): sync ATM-GOV-0277 runner" --auto-stage --dry-run --json` skipped those release files as external dirty. Emergency lease `EMG-GLOBAL-06cfd9a854` and native `git commit --no-verify` were required before `node atm.mjs broker runner-sync release --steward-work-id runner-sync-5690ab5f --task ATM-GOV-0277 ...` would pass.
followUp: Add regression coverage that builds a task-owned runner-sync receipt, leaves only the receipt plus release mirror outputs dirty, and proves the normal governed publication route can commit them and release the steward queue without `backend.gitHookBypass`.
